prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Dallas for a roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single universally “best” roofing company for every Dallas roof replacement — the right contractor depends on where you are in Dallas, your roof type and materials, whether you’re filing an insurance claim, your budget, and how important warranty/turnaround is to you.

I can either (A) list and compare top-rated local roofers for your ZIP code, or (B) give a concise checklist so you can quickly vet bids. Which would you prefer? If you want option A, tell me your ZIP or neighborhood and whether this is an insurance job.

If you want the quick checklist now, use this when evaluating any Dallas roofer:

Must-checks
- Local experience: Have they done many roof replacements in Dallas / North Texas? Local experience matters for storm patterns and code/permit familiarity.
- Insurance & registration: Verify general liability and workers’ comp coverage. Ask for copies of certificates. Some Texas cities require contractor registration—confirm they comply.
- Written estimate & contract: Get a detailed, written scope (materials, brand & product codes, underlayment, ventilation, ice/wind ratings, nails, flashing, gutters if included), timeline, cleanup, and payment schedule.
- Warranties: Distinguish manufacturer shingle warranty vs. contractor workmanship warranty. Get both in writing.
- References and photos: Ask for recent references and before/after photos of full reroofs (not just small repairs).
- Reviews & complaints: Check Google reviews, Yelp, BBB, Angi/HomeAdvisor, and search for any storm-chaser/red-flag complaints.
- Permits & inspections: Contractor should obtain required Dallas permits and arrange municipal inspections.
- Payment terms: Avoid large up-front cash payments; typical is partial deposit with balance on completion. Be cautious with contractors insisting on full payment up front.
- Storm-chaser warning: If they solicit aggressively after a storm and don’t have a local office, be cautious.

Questions to ask each contractor
- How long have you been operating in Dallas?
- Can you provide proof of insurance and local registration?
- Which shingle brand and class (e.g., architectural, 30-50 year) do you recommend and why?
- Do you use ridge/soffit ventilation—will attic ventilation be inspected?
- What underlayment/ice & water barrier do you install and where?
- Who will file the permit and contact the city for inspection?
- What exactly does your cleanup include? Do you use a magnet to pick up nails?
- Who do I contact if there’s a problem after installation? How long is your workmanship warranty?

How I can help next
- If you give me your Dallas ZIP code (and say whether it’s an insurance job), I’ll compile a short, vetted list of top-rated local roofers and a comparison checklist to help you choose.  
- Or paste any written estimates here and I’ll compare them line-by-line and point out red flags.

Which would you like?
